_comment: Storage layout of BaseArbExecutorUpgradeable as deployed behind the live UUPS proxy,
captured at commit 408c56f. The proxy holds this state; the implementation only
describes how to read it. Any new variable inserted before the end shifts every slot
after it, so an upgrade would make `owner` read what `pendingOwner` held -- zero on a
proxy that never started a handover -- and brick the contract beyond recovery, taking
the adapter and token allowlists with it.
test_storage_layout_is_upgrade_safe.py asserts every entry below still sits at the same
slot and offset. Appending new state past the last entry is allowed; anything else is
not. Do not edit this file to make a test pass.
